rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused sandhi form combining siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam; denotes attainment of powers as the root Kaula

items.question: What additional attainments and foundational Kaula teaching are declared, O fair-faced one?
premises: The conjunction links these items to prior statements.
Attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: Eight attainments, culminating in the attainment of powers, constitute the foundational Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact eight items may be specified in the surrounding context rather than within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And there are eight, O fair-faced one: the attainment of powers, which is the root Kaula.
